svg.title: A discretized value function against a fitted one, and the cost of discretizing
svg.desc: Left: the optimal value function of a one-dimensional MDP, a smooth bowl from minus 32.5 at the edges to minus 0.26 at the origin, drawn with the six-step staircase that a six-cell discretization produces, which misses it by up to 15, and the curve fitted value iteration produces with five polynomial features, which follows it to within 1.8, its worst miss being a slight overshoot at the origin; faint dots are the fitted targets on the last iteration. Right: the base-ten logarithm of the number of cells, k to the n, against the dimension n, for k equal to 10 and 100, with the inverted pendulum at n equal to 4, the car at 6 and the helicopter at 12 marked on the k equal to 10 line.
